title: Invocation Attribution Pipeline: Compact Token-Cost View & CSV Export Prototype
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Design a compact, scannable panel in Redwood Console that surfaces token-level cost attribution per invocation, with a lightweight export path for CSV/JSON. Background: Platform teams and finance need a small, embeddable view that can live inside per-route dashboards and customer pages so engineers can quickly triage cost spikes without leaving context. Scope: compact panel (collapsed/expanded states), token breakdown (prompt/system/completion), model-variant split, basic attribution by route/user, role-aware column visibility, and CSV/JSON export. Out of scope for this ticket: full-cost drilldown page, billing ingestion pipelines, and long-term storage/export archival features.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Compact panel fits within 320–480px width column without horizontal scroll. 2) Shows per-invocation summary: invocation_id, timestamp, user, route, model_variant, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, system_tokens, total_cost (USD). 3) Filters: date range, route, model_variant, user; persistent across panel expansions. 4) Column visibility respects role (admins see internal IDs; support sees user-facing columns only). 5) CSV/JSON export includes normalized fields and metadata: export_version, generated_by, currency, exchange_rate_ts. 6) Panel interaction performance: initial render <= 350ms on a 200-row sample. 7) Handoff artefacts: Figma frames, CSV schema examples, and GitHub PR with storybook story.
